module.purpose: Provides LRU memoization utilities for function caching, used by reselect selectors to avoid recomputation.
module.summary: This module implements memoization with either a singleton or LRU cache. It exports lruMemoize, referenceEqualityCheck, createCacheKeyComparator, and LruMemoizeOptions. It supports argument equality checks and optional result equality checks to reuse prior outputs, attaching cache management methods to the memoized function.
module.businessContext: Caching layer for derived data selectors; if broken, selectors recompute unnecessarily or return stale data.
classes: Entry (~L14-17): Cache entry holding key and value pairs
functions: createSingletonCache (~L26-49): Builds a single-entry cache object
createLruCache (~L51-93): Builds an LRU cache with max size eviction
lruMemoize (~L188-249): Memoizes function with LRU cache

detail.name: createSingletonCache
preconditions: The equals function must be a pure function returning a boolean for any two arguments it receives.
The equals function should produce consistent results: if equals(a,b) returns true, then equals(b,a) should also return true.
postconditions: Returns a Cache object exposing get, put, getEntries, and clear methods conforming to the Cache interface.
invariants: The cache holds at most one entry at any given time.
The entry, when present, contains both key and value properties.
edgeCases: Before any put is called, get returns NOT_FOUND for any key.
put overwrites the previous entry if one exists.
clear resets the entry to undefined, causing subsequent get calls to return NOT_FOUND.
getEntries returns an array containing the single entry if present, or an empty array if no entry exists.
stateMutations: Closure-local variable entry is written by put and reset to undefined by clear.
detail.summary: Creates a singleton cache that holds at most one entry at a time, using the provided equality function to determine key matches during retrieval.

specTests.when: get is called with any key
get is called with that matching key

units.name: createLruCache

detail.name: createLruCache
detail.signature: function createLruCache(maxSize: number, equals: EqualityFn): Cache
preconditions: maxSize should be a non-negative number; negative values behave identically to 0 (cache always empty)
equals must be a deterministic, symmetric, total equality function for correct key matching
postconditions: Returns a Cache object exposing get, put, getEntries, and clear methods
entries.length never exceeds maxSize after any operation completes
invariants: entries.length <= maxSize after all operations complete
entries[0] is always the most-recently-used entry; entries[entries.length - 1] is always the least-recently-used
get uses strict equality (===) to compare its return against NOT_FOUND, so falsy cached values (0, false, null, undefined) are never confused with cache misses
put on an existing key does not overwrite the stored value; it only reorders via get's side effect
edgeCases: Cache miss: get returns NOT_FOUND with no side effects on entries
Cache full: put adds a new entry via unshift then pops the last (LRU) entry when entries.length exceeds maxSize
put on existing key: get is called first (which may reorder the matched entry to index 0), the value is not updated, and no new entry is added since get does not return NOT_FOUND
get on entry at index 0: no reordering occurs, value returned directly
maxSize = 0: every put adds then immediately pops the entry, cache is always empty, get always returns NOT_FOUND
clear() replaces the entries array with a new empty array, disconnecting any prior getEntries reference
getEntries() returns the raw internal entries array by reference, allowing external mutation that bypasses LRU logic

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: get returns NOT_FOUND sentinel for cache misses; no exceptions are thrown by any returned cache method

stateMutations: entries array (internal): get may reorder via splice+unshift, put may add via unshift and remove via pop, clear reassigns to a new empty array
detail.summary: Creates an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache bounded by maxSize that evicts the least-recently-used entry when capacity is exceeded, using the provided equality function to match keys and returning NOT_FOUND for cache misses.

specTests.then: returns NOT_FOUND (cache miss sentinel), entries array unchanged
entries become [C, B], 'A' (LRU) is evicted, cache.get('A') returns NOT_FOUND
entries reordered to [A, C, B], returns 1

detail.name: createCacheKeyComparator
detail.returnType: (prev: unknown[] | IArguments | null, next: unknown[] | IArguments | null) => boolean
preconditions: equalityCheck must be a function accepting two unknown values and returning a boolean
postconditions: The returned comparator returns false if prev or next is null, or if their lengths differ
The returned comparator returns false as soon as any element pair fails the equalityCheck
The returned comparator returns true only when all element pairs pass the equalityCheck and no error path was hit
invariants: The comparator never throws on null or length mismatch inputs
The comparator short-circuits on the first unequal element
edgeCases: prev is null: returns false without invoking equalityCheck
next is null: returns false without invoking equalityCheck
prev.length !== next.length: returns false without invoking equalityCheck
Empty arrays or IArguments of equal length: returns true (loop body never executes)
First element pair unequal: returns false immediately without checking remaining elements

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: No fallback; relies on caller-provided equalityCheck for element-level errors

detail.summary: Given an equalityCheck function, returns a comparator that determines whether two sets of arguments are shallowly equal for cache key comparison, returning false on null inputs or length mismatch and otherwise applying equalityCheck pairwise across the argument sequences.

detail.name: areArgumentsShallowlyEqual
detail.signature: return function areArgumentsShallowlyEqual(prev: unknown[] | IArguments | null, next: unknown[] | IArguments | null): boolean
preconditions: equalityCheck is bound in the enclosing scope
Both prev and next are either arrays, IArguments, or null
postconditions: Returns a boolean indicating shallow equality
Never mutates prev, next, or any referenced objects
invariants: Equality is determined by length match and pairwise equalityCheck results
Iteration order is index-ascending from 0 to length-1
edgeCases: prev === null -> returns false
next === null -> returns false
prev.length !== next.length -> returns false
Both empty collections with equal length -> returns true (no iterations)
First element mismatch -> returns false immediately

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No throwing; null and mismatched-length inputs yield false rather than errors

detail.summary: Compares two argument collections for shallow equality, returning true only when both are non-null, have equal length, and every corresponding pair of elements passes the equalityCheck predicate.

detail.name: lruMemoize
detail.signature: export function lruMemoize<Func extends AnyFunction>(func: Func, equalityCheckOrOptions?: EqualityFn | LruMemoizeOptions<ReturnType<Func>>)
preconditions: if equalityCheckOrOptions is an object, maxSize must be a positive integer
postconditions: returns a callable function that caches results based on argument equality
the returned function exposes clearCache, resultsCount, and resetResultsCount methods
invariants: cache key is derived from serialized arguments via comparator
resultsCount reflects the number of uncached computations (decremented when a resultEqualityCheck match is found)
edgeCases: when equalityCheckOrOptions is undefined, defaults to referenceEqualityCheck, maxSize 1, no resultEqualityCheck
when maxSize <= 1, a singleton cache (capacity 1) is used instead of an LRU cache
when resultEqualityCheck is provided, previously cached results with equal values are reused and resultsCount is decremented
detail.summary: Wraps a function with an LRU memoization cache keyed by its arguments, caching up to maxSize entries and returning cached results on subsequent calls with equivalent arguments.

specLiterals.role: default/maxSize value that triggers singleton cache usage when maxSize <= 1

detail.name: memoized
preconditions: The closure must be called within the context of a `lruMemoize(func)` invocation where `cache`, `func`, `resultsCount`, and `resultEqualityCheck` are bound
postconditions: If a cached value exists for `arguments`, it is returned unchanged
If no cached value exists, `func` is invoked with `arguments`, the result is stored in `cache`, and `resultsCount` is incremented
The same arguments always produce the same return value within the lifetime of the cache entry
invariants: Every value placed into `cache` via `cache.put` is retrievable via `cache.get` with identical arguments
`resultsCount` is incremented exactly once per new cache miss computation before equality checking

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit input validation; behavior is determined by `cache` and `func` implementations

stateMutations: resultsCount (incremented on miss, possibly decremented on duplicate)
